summary: This note is a short biographical entry on William Henry Boyce, an American lawyer and Democratic politician from Delaware. It states his birth and death dates and places him in Georgetown (Sussex County) and later Dover (Kent County). It notes he served as an Associate Justice of the Delaware Superior Court and as a U.S. Representative from Delaware.
one_line: William H. Boyce was a Delaware Democrat who served as a Superior Court associate justice and U.S. Representative.
key_facts: William Henry Boyce was born on November 28, 1855.
William Henry Boyce died on February 6, 1942.
William H. Boyce was an American lawyer and politician.
William H. Boyce was from Georgetown, in Sussex County, Delaware.
William H. Boyce later lived in Dover, in Kent County, Delaware.
William H. Boyce was a member of the Democratic Party.
William H. Boyce served as Associate Justice of the Delaware Superior Court.
William H. Boyce served as a U.S. Representative from Delaware.
